HANZA’s unique business model simplifies supply chains and offers an integrated solution for all manufacturing services. All you need is one . Erik Stenfors, CEO What is HANZA? HANZA is Europe’s fastest-growing, publicly listed contract manufacturer, with the goal of making manufacturing easy. Our local presence close to customers worldwide, brings security and flexibility. By bringing technologies together, we simplify complex supply chains and provide a true one-stop manufacturing solution. HANZA delivers manufacturing services across six core technologies: electronics, sheet metal mechanics, heavy mechanics, wire harnesses, machining, and assembly services. Our values We are focused We make things easier We are team players We communicate We take ownership We are always in motion – growing, scaling, improving and making manufacturing easy. HANZA helps you to identify the potential for improvements and streamline your manufacturing chain . What is it? To help boost your long-term growth and profitability, we developed our MIG™ business consulting services.The core is an in-depth four-to-eight-week business analysis of your production process designed to streamline your manufacturing chain. Starting with your strategic objectives, we evaluate your stakeholder requirements, the economic and political situation, current regulations as well as evolving technology and market changes. Then we make a comprehensive outsourcing evaluation to analyze risks and opportunities related to potential transition plans. The resulting report is a vital tool for senior management on what steps to take next. MIG = Manufacturing solutions for Increased Growth and earnings What MIG includes? • Cost/benefit analysis, including joint objectives • List of resources and assets to be taken over by provider, including book value • List of contracts/agreements to be taken over by provider • Cost break down for all products/product categories • Cost saving potential (direct and indirect) and required investment • Risk register including countermeasures • Transfer plan and budget from client factory to provider factory • Draft layout/process flow in provider factory • Draft Provider Sourcing Strategy • Realistic multi-year price development target Cost savings of up to 40%, significantly reduced inventory and faster time-to-market.
